description.en: 返回信息中是否包含第三方信息，默认不包含。

description.zh: 第三方系统的用户 id：若是钉钉同步，则是钉钉的员工 User ID；与provider参数成对使用，只传其中一个，不生效。
description.en: User ID in the third-party system: if synchronized from DingTalk, this is the DingTalk employee User ID. This parameter must be used together with the provider parameter. Specifying only one of them has no effect.

description.en: Time when the user joined the Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization, in milliseconds as a UNIX timestamp.
Maximum number of results to return, ranging from 0 to 50. Default value is 20.

description.zh: 分页中的起始序列，值为上一页请求返回的nextToken值。
description.en: Starting token for paging; use the nextToken value returned from the previous request.
Organization identity, also known as organization ID

description.zh: 第三方系统（若是钉钉同步，则是 Dingtalk）， 与externUid参数成对使用，只传其中一个，不生效。
description.en: Third-party system (for example, DingTalk if synchronized from DingTalk). This parameter must be used together with the externUid parameter. Specifying only one of them has no effect.

description.zh: 选项：正常（normal），已停用（blocked），已删除（deleted），只能指定一种；若不指定，默认返回正常（normal）状态的成员。
description.en: Options: Normal (normal), Blocked (blocked), Deleted (deleted). Only one status can be specified. If not specified, members with Normal status are returned by default.
